name: 🎉 City RNG [RELEASE] 🎉
desc:
🏙️ Welcome to City RNG! 🎉✨
Build your fantastic city, one roll at a time! 🎲🏗️ Craft gorgeous monuments, gain rare buildings, and watch your metropolis thrive! Can you create the ultimate city and become the best city planner? 🏆🌟

✨ Features:

🍀 Roll for RARE buildings to boost your city's growth!
🛠️ Craft stunning monuments with collected materials!
💰 Earn money with commercial buildings to expand your empire!
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Increase population with residential buildings!
📈 Purchase upgrades to enhance city activity and prosperity!

👍 2k Likes Goal for exciting new updates! 
⭐ 10k Favorites Goal to unlock special in-game bonuses! 🎁✨

✔️ Premium Benefits: Access exclusive building designs and faster city development! 🏗️⚡

Tags: City, Build, Simulator, RNG, Roll, Craft, Monument, Commercial, Residential, Upgrade, Fun, Tycoon, Adventure.
